scope: allowed training only; raw mm/s; descriptive, no rejection/filtering
interpretation: RMS warning uses descriptive 0.5–2 range, not a physical acceptance criterion. Relative waveform L2 uses synchronized unshifted z-score windows; shifted copies may escape detection. Training extrema are a diagnostic reference, not sensor clipping limits. Good reconstruction does not guarantee good prior-generated signals.
